question: Extend the giving-circle term census from the 33-CF systematic sample to all top-100 CFs (and the repo's long-tail CF list) using the robots-checked sitemap scan in scripts/mission_b50_04_giving_circles.py plus each CF's fund-type one-pagers (PDF), coding minimum, fee, vehicle (DAF / non-endowed / endowed / field-of-interest) and who recommends grants
conclusion_affected: Share of CFs with a published giving-circle fund product (2 of 35 CF rows so far: Idaho, Triangle); typical circle-fund minimum and fee
rationale: In the sample only 1 of 33 CFs published explicit circle-fund terms; 12 host named circles without terms; 11 had nothing findable. Sitemaps miss PDFs and pages named 'giving group' or 'affinity fund', so a fund-type PDF pass is needed

question: Are giving-circle funds donor-advised funds? Collect sponsor statements on the legal form of circle funds (Thrivent and the African American Legacy Fund say DAF; Minneapolis' RMD Giving Circle takes IRA QCDs, which cannot go to a DAF) and map them to the definition in IRC 4966(d)(2) and the Nov 2023 proposed DAF regulations (advisory-committee and 'donor-advisor' rules)
conclusion_affected: Whether circle money is inside or outside DAF statistics (DAFRC, Schedule D); OBBBA / excise exposure of circle funds
rationale: Primary pages disagree on vehicle: two sponsors state DAF form, Idaho and Triangle describe component or non-endowed funds advised by the group, and a QCD-funded circle implies a non-DAF fund. The Council on Foundations FAQ said to address this returned HTTP 403

question: Grapevine Giving Foundation (EIN 87-2389502): why does Schedule D Part I report one DAF while hosting over 1,000 circles? Read the FY2023-FY2025 990 Part III and Schedule O narratives and reconcile Schedule D contributions ($10.1m FY2023; $9.9m FY2024; $9.2m FY2025) with Grapevine's '$60 million+ since 2020' and DAFRC's imputed FY2024 DAF assets ($4,508,877)
conclusion_affected: Whether platform-hosted circle flows are counted as DAF flows in market totals; the platform channel's size
rationale: Schedule D counts 1 DAF in every year FY2022-FY2025, so circle money is either reported as a single DAF or partly outside DAF lines. DAFRC classifies the filer as a 'Donation Processor' with imputed FY2024 assets
